Misc. File No. 441/37
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
West Hongkew Station,
REPORT
Date 16th Nov. 1937
Subject Assistance to Special Branch.
Made by J. W. Sambrook Forwarded by (签名) 17/11
Sir,
At 11.30 a.m. on November 16th 1937 D.S. Hocking and D.S.I.
Suih Ssu Chien, attached to the Special Branch, came to West
Hongkew Station and requested assistance to visit House No. 47
Lane 724 Tiendong Road, where a political organization known as
the "Shanghai Printing Circles War Time Service Group" were be-
lieved to be operating.
The necessary assistance was rendered by D. . . 854 and the
undersigned, who, upon proceeding to the aforementioned address,
found it to be the "Tai An" (泰安) Primary School, of whom
one named Tong Wei Ming (湯惟明) claimed to be the president.
This man when questioned by detectives readily admitted that the
abovementioned association had previously operated there. He
stated, however, that the parties concerned removed about one
week ago.
In an upstairs back room a quantity of literature and two
printing blocks were seized by the aforementioned detectives who
transmitted same to Headquarters.
No arrests were made.
J. W. Sambrook
Det. Sergt.
Sen. Det. i/c.
S. I. /
D.D.O. "C" Div.
(签名) 17/11
C.P.I. Ross,
Special Branch.

杂项档案号 441/37
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
虹口西区捕房，
报告
日期：1937年11月16日
事由：协助特别支部。
具报人：J. W. Sambrook 转呈人：（签名）11月17日

先生，
1937年11月16日上午11时30分，隶属于特别支部的警佐 Hocking 和巡官 Suih Ssu Chien 来到虹口西区捕房，请求协助前往天潼路724弄47号，据信一个名为“上海印刷界战时服务团”的政治组织正在该处活动。

由警员编号 854 及具报人提供了必要协助。我们前往上述地址后，发现该处为“泰安”小学，一名叫汤惟明（Tong Wei Ming）的人声称是该校校长。经侦探讯问，此人 readily 承认上述协会此前曾在此运作。但他称，相关人员约于一周前搬离。

在楼上的后间，上述侦探查获了大量宣传品和两块印刷版，并将其移送至总局。
未实施逮捕。

J. W. Sambrook
警佐
高级侦探长
C区副督察长
（签名）11月17日

C.P.I. Ross,
特别支部。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

S.I., Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date November 3, 1937.
Subject Posting Anti-Traitor and Patriotic Pamphlets in West Hongkew
District - Arrest of Three Persons.
Made by D.S.I. Shih Ssu-chien. Forwarded by
At 12 noon on November 2, 1937, the three male Chinese
described below were taken into custody by the police of the
West Hongkew Police Station for posting posters on walls along
North Honan, Shanse and Boone Roads :-
(1) Zao Hoong Mei (曹洪美), 28, Hunan, M/Printer, residing
at 10 San Sing Li, Rue Soeur Allegre, French Concession.
(2) Zee Ts Yuan (徐子元), 25, Kiangwan, I/Printer, 19/75
Ferry Road, C.C.L.
(3) Han Yan King (韓彥卿), 24, Lotien, M/Printer, 47 Tai
An Li, Tiendon Road.
Then interrogated at the West Hongkew Station by
detectives from the Special Branch in conjunction with staff of
West Hongkew Station, the above persons admitted being members
of the "Shanghai Municipality Printing Circles War Time Service
Corps" (上海印刷界戰時服務團) with an office still functioning
at No.47 Tai An Li, Tiendon Road. At about 9 a.m. November 2,
one Ting Tsoo Yao (丁祖堯), an executive member of the above
organization, handed them some 300 copies of pamphlets of a
national salvation nature with instructions to post same on
walls in the West Hongkew District. As far as they were aware,
these pamphlets were issued to the above organization by the
All Shanghai Association for the Support of Armed Resistance,
(上海各界抗敵後援會), the address of which they stated they
had no knowledge.
According to the arrested persons, the Shanghai
Municipality Printing Circles War Time Service Corps came into
existence on or about August 20, 1937 with an office at that
time on Burkill Road but later removed to the present address.

特别支部捕房，
报告
日期：1937年11月3日。
事由：在虹口西区张贴反汉奸及爱国传单——逮捕三人。
具报人：巡官 Shih Ssu-chien。转呈人：

1937年11月2日中午12时，下述三名中国男子因在河南路、山西路和 Boone 路（博山路）沿墙张贴海报，被虹口西区捕房警方拘留：
(1) 曹洪美（Zao Hoong Mei），28岁，湖南人，男/印刷工，住法租界雷米路（Rue Soeur Allegre）三兴里10号。
(2) 徐子元（Zee Ts Yuan），25岁，江湾人，印/印刷工，住华界斐伦路19/75号。
(3) 韩彦卿（Han Yan King），24岁，乐天人，男/印刷工，住天潼路泰安里47号。

随后，特别支部侦探会同虹口西区捕房人员在虹口西区捕房对上述人员进行了审讯，他们承认是“上海印刷界战时服务团”的成员，该团办事处仍位于天潼路泰安里47号。据称，11月2日上午9时许，该组织执行委员丁祖尧（Ting Tsoo Yao）交给他们约300份抗日救国性质的传单，并指示将其张贴在虹口西区的墙壁上。据他们所知，这些传单是由“上海各界抗敌后援会”发给上述组织的，但他们表示不知晓该会的地址。

据被捕人员称，上海印刷界战时服务团成立于1937年8月20日左右，当时办事处设在伯基尔路（Burkill Road），后迁至现址。被捕者进一步声称，该组织的目标是参与抗日救国运动。
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 - 1937年11月3日 特别支部）

Acting on the instruction of the D.O."C" Division, the

A translation of the seized pamphlets, 7 kinds in all,

1. Effect the arrest of Traitor Lee Sz-hoa (李士豪)!
2. Support General Chiang Kai-shek, and resist against
aggression to the bitter end!
3. Down with the traitors who propose a compromise!
4. Traitors are public enemies and therefore, may be
killed by anyone!
5. The citizens should arm themselves to guard Greater
Shanghai!
6. Only traitors will propose a compromise!
7. To have a compromise before we succeed is the way to
Death!
D. S. I.
D.C. (Special Branch).

直至目前，成员约有600人，均为三界（指公共租界、法租界、华界）内印刷公司的现任或前任雇员。该组织的负责人描述如下：
陈岳章（Zun H'oh Chang）先生，海宁路大东印刷所雇员；
丁祖耀（Ting Tsoo Yao）先生，大连路世界印刷所雇员；
汤洪林（Tong Hon Ling）先生，同上；
姚瑞禎（Yao Zai Ling）先生，同上；
该组织未向工部局警务处注册。
根据C区督察长的指示，虹口西区捕房于1937年11月3日晚7时15分，在对三名被捕人员进行正式告诫后予以释放。
查获传单的译文如下，共7种：
1. 逮捕汉奸李士豪！
2. 拥护蒋介石将军，抗战到底！
3. 打倒主张妥协的汉奸！
4. 汉奸是公敌，人人得而诛之！
5. 市民应武装起来保卫大上海！
6. 只有汉奸才会主张妥协！
7. 成功之前求妥协即是死路一条！

巡官
侦探长（特别支部）。
